profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. Per its site, it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with what it calls the industry's leading process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions. The company says its business model accelerates innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications, and that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, trading under the ticker TSM, with CIK 0001046179. Its site material centers on semiconductor manufacturing and design enablement rather than on named AI products, and no litigation, MCP servers, or product listings are recorded alongside it.
